SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(s ORDER BY s.scanned_at DESC), '[]'::json)
   FROM (SELECT scanned_at, trigger_type, total_launches, sent_to_llm,
                stale_count, interesting_count, watch_count, skip_count
         FROM scan_summary ORDER BY scanned_at DESC LIMIT 48) s) AS scans,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t ORDER BY t.scanned_at DESC), '[]'::json)
   FROM (SELECT scanned_at, symbol, chain, rating, age_minutes,
                price_usd, vl_ratio, vol_trend, micro_trend, buy_pct_5m,
                flags, reasoning,
                entry_price, target_price, stop_price,
                price_at_5m, price_at_15m, price_at_30m,
                target_hit, stop_hit
         FROM token_signals ORDER BY scanned_at DESC LIMIT 200) t) AS signals,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scan_summary  WHERE scanned_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS scans_today,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM token_signals WHERE scanned_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS signals_today,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM token_signals WHERE rating = 'INTERESTING' AND scanned_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS interesting_today,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scan_summary) AS total_scans
